subtitle: The people who make this place home.
name: Household name
save_error: Could not save this change. Check your permissions and try again; this person may already belong to a household.
add_description: Choose how to add someone to your household.
existing_hint: Choose someone who already uses HomeSystem and does not belong to a household.
invite_hint: No email is sent. Ask this person to sign in with this email address within 30 days. Existing users are added immediately.
managed_hint: Create a profile for someone without a login, such as a child.
role_hint: Owners manage the household. Adults can edit shared resources. Children can view shared resources and manage their own data. Guests can view shared resources only.
invitation_created: Invitation created. Ask them to sign in; no email was sent.
last_owner: Your household needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner before leaving or removing the current owner.
remove_warning: This person will lose access to the household's shared resources.
revoke_warning: This invitation will no longer allow the recipient to join your household.
load_error: Could not load your household. Try again.
setup_description: We'll create your home. You can change its name and add people later.
rename_later: You can change this name whenever you like.
ready_description: You can start using it now. Adding other people is optional, and you can invite them later.
leave_warning: You will lose access to this household's shared resources. An owner will need to add you again to rejoin.
delete_warning: This will delete the household and remove all memberships. Everyone will lose access to its shared resources. This cannot be undone.
